findings.description: If os.replace has already succeeded, or if the failure happened after the temp file was removed, os.unlink(tmp_name) raises FileNotFoundError and hides the original exception. The bare except also catches KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit. In that case the cleanup error replaces the real I/O failure, so callers see a misleading error.
findings.suggestion: Use `except BaseException:` with `contextlib.suppress(FileNotFoundError): os.unlink(tmp_name)` (or `except Exception`) and then re-raise the original error.
findings.title: Bare except with unguarded unlink can mask the original error

findings.description: The old get() deleted an expired session when it was looked up. The new get() only returns None, so expired entries stay in memory (and in the file for FileSessionStore) until purge_expired is called. If nothing calls purge_expired, the store grows without bound and expired sessions keep being persisted.
findings.suggestion: Make sure purge_expired runs periodically, or remove the expired entry under the write lock in get().
findings.title: Expired sessions are no longer removed on access
